_comment: v3.2 reranker MVP combo sweep. Per (task, seed): retriever = the WS2 per-task qh1 cell (runs/sweep_taskdiversity/task{T}_seed{S}) for tasks 0/1/3/4/5; for temporal task 2 (no WS2 cell) the v3.1 baseline qh0 -- included specifically to verify the residual's no-regression guarantee on the locality-friendly task where WS3 regressed. Trains a fresh v2 (reused arch) as a learned residual on the retriever score (scale init 0 => regression-proof), candidate-restricted ListNet loss on the retriever's hard top-C. Gate: on geometry-sensitive tasks {0,3,4,5} v3.2 gap_closed_frac must EXCEED WS3's per-task v2 gap_closed_frac (from runs/sweep_v2reranker/sweep_v2reranker_results.json), AND regression_vs_retriever must be False on EVERY task (especially temporal).
